Prithvi Commercial Bank
Bank Guarantee Department
BG No: BG/87
Date: June 4, 2021
To,
The Employer / Commissioner
Subject: Performance Bond — Roads Highways Works (Tender RFP-132009118)
Dear Sir / Madam,
At the request of M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (the Contractor), we, Prithvi
Commercial Bank, hereby irrevocably and unconditionally undertake to pay you, on first written
demand and without demur, any sum not exceeding INR 0 (Rupees 0 Only) toward the
Contractor's obligations under the captioned tender.
This guarantee remains in force up to and including August 10, 2024, after which it stands
automatically discharged unless a claim in writing is received by us on or before that date. Our
liability is restricted to the amount stated above. Payment instructions: IFSC KNBX0004417.
Authorised Signatory
Prithvi Commercial Bank
